scope: Whole-page visual and persuasion review requested after owner rejected the arm/hand insert. Review only: frontend unchanged.
owner_feedback: Arm photograph looks too dark relative to the page; adjacent clip shows application without a clear finished swatch. Review the whole page.
finding: Source selection and inconsistent photographic treatment undermine continuity between desired makeup result, shade selection, texture and recommended use. Source authenticity and responsive QA did not establish purchase appeal.

observations.observation: Finished cheek glow is visible, but opening lacks a clear product-body image. Full product trio appears near the end.
observations.direction: Retain real finished-result evidence and introduce original product photography earlier without another repeated portrait block.

observations.observation: The three official shade images are relatively consistent and useful for named colour comparison.
observations.direction: Preserve original colours, names and shared family layout; do not attach unknown-shade footage to a shade name.

observations.observation: Darker warm exposure and hard reflective swatch contrast sharply with the lighter adjacent hand image and official cheek photos. Close framing emphasizes skin texture and individual glitter.
observations.direction: Remove this candidate. Do not interpret dark skin itself as an aesthetic defect or lighten skin to manufacture an appealing swatch.

observations.observation: The selected 2.4-second clip shows continued application; fingers and stick obscure the area, and there is no clear hands-away final-result hold.
observations.direction: Reject as finished-swatch evidence. Any replacement must show the finished result unobstructed; classify application footage separately.

observations.observation: Thick pink scraped texture followed by extreme pearl macro can suggest a coarse or thick finish and visually conflicts with the soft-stick headline.
observations.direction: Reduce repeated extreme close-ups; select source evidence of texture spread and actual finished skin appearance.

observations.observation: Four-person footage mixes lighting and includes direct stick application, while written recommendation says fingertip application followed by edge-only sponge blending.
observations.direction: Usage imagery must show the recommended technique. Results footage should be identified and placed as results, with original source bytes preserved.

observations.observation: Formula is supporting information; closing trio clearly communicates the product but arrives late.
observations.direction: Keep formula subordinate and make product appearance evident earlier.

acceptance_criteria: Finished glow unobstructed by hands or stick, with time to inspect it.
Consistent perceived lighting/white balance across selected source cuts; do not recolour skin or product to fake consistency.
Named shade comparisons require actual provenance.
One clear role per image: product appearance, finished makeup, shade difference, or correct application.
No repeated face enlargements or restored rejected FAQ/slogans.
next_action: Re-select original assets by these criteria before another page edit; do not treat the rejected arm/hand insert as approved.
